buildCommand: PNPM_PIN=$(node -p "const v=(require('../../../package.json').packageManager||'').split('+')[0];if(!v.startsWith('pnpm@'))throw new Error('root package.json must pin pnpm in its packageManager field');v") && npx --yes --package "$PNPM_PIN" -- pnpm run build
installCommand: cd ../../.. && if [ ! -f .pnpmfile.cjs ]; then cp packages/apps/site/pnpmfile.cjs .pnpmfile.cjs; fi && PNPM_PIN=$(node -p "const v=(require('./package.json').packageManager||'').split('+')[0];if(!v.startsWith('pnpm@'))throw new Error('root package.json must pin pnpm in its packageManager field');v") && npx --yes --package "$PNPM_PIN" -- pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --reporter=append-only
